subject: Nanotechnology
title: Perovskite Solar Cells
description: A short lesson to help you apply Perovskite Solar Cells.

hook.text: In 2009, perovskite solar cells were 3.8% efficient — by 2024 they hit 33.9% in tandem with silicon.

buildup.text: Halide perovskites absorb light in layers just 500 nm thick — a hundred times thinner than silicon wafers.

discovery.text: Solution processing at low temperatures means cheap fabrication — no billion-dollar clean rooms needed.

twist.text: Perovskites degrade in moisture, heat, and UV — stability remains the biggest barrier to commercialization.

climax.text: Encapsulation and 2D-3D heterostructures now extend lifetimes to years — several companies plan mass production.

punchline.text: A nano-thin crystal film rivals decades of silicon engineering.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge preventing perovskite solar cell commercialization?
options: Degradation from moisture, heat, and UV reduces long-term stability
They require extremely expensive raw materials
